API ReferenceZscaler Cloud & Branch Connector APILocation ManagementGet All Location Templates
Get All Location Templates
GET
https://api.zsapi.net/ztw/api/v1/locationTemplate

Lists location templates.

Request
​
QUERY PARAMETERS
page
int32

Specifies the page offset.

Default value: 1
pageSize
int32

Specifies the page size. The default size is 250.

Default value: 100
Responses
​
default

Default Response. See API Response Codes

APPLICATION/JSON
Schema
Example (auto)
SCHEMA
Array [
id
int32

ID of Cloud & Branch Connector location template.

name
string

Name of Cloud & Branch Connector location template.

desc
string

Description of Cloud & Branch Connector location template.

template
object
editable
boolean

Whether Cloud & Branch Connector location template is editable.

lastModUid
object
lastModTime
int32

Last time Cloud & Branch Connector location template was modified.

]
